title: Routing
description: Where the router tied something received from outside (doctrine D-056): its object, its thread, the holding it made — by a rule, by the model's intent with its confidence, or by a person. Under the threshold it is not guessed: a card « à classer » asks a person.

received.description: What was received: its channel and its own reference there.

intent.description: What it is about, in the product's words: incident, quote_request, invoice_request…

by.description: rule: a known number, address or thread. model: its intent above the threshold. person: a card « à classer » settled.

asked.description: The holding of the card « à classer », when a person must decide.
